properties.name: cpf.openapi.webmvc.enabled
properties.description: Enables the CPF OpenAPI Web MVC capability when the starter is selected.

properties.name: cpf.openapi.webmvc.api-docs-enabled
properties.description: Exposes runtime API docs. Disabled by default.

properties.name: cpf.openapi.webmvc.management-enabled
properties.description: Enables sanitized health and actuator status.
